displayName: OLX API - Listings, Ads, Sellers, 7 OLX Europe Markets
description: OLX API as structured JSON for the OLX Europe sites (olx.pl, olx.ro, olx.pt, olx.bg, olx.ua, olx.kz, olx.uz) - search classified ads by keyword or category, sorted by newest or price and filtered by price, condition, private or business seller, OLX delivery, photos, region, city or district with a radius and each category's own filters (rooms, area, year, mileage) listed by the filters endpoint, up to 1,000 results per search with promoted ads flagged by slot; read one ad in full (every parameter, category breadcrumb, photos, location, job salary range); read a seller's business flag, business name, member-since date and live ads; and look up the category tree, location ids, search suggestions and similar ads. Prices in each site's currency. 9 endpoints, 1 credit each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
